messages:
Danielle: Heads up — Parklane Health says invoice INV-2029-045 charged full monthly platform fee for April. They were offline Mar 22-29 due to failed private deploy migration, asking for proration/credit.
Maria: Can you paste the invoice lines and any SLA claim from the customer? Need to see billing ID and dates.
Danielle: Invoice partial snippet:
```
INV-2029-045
 - PLATFORM_FEE: $12,500 (Apr 1 - Apr 30)
 - SUPPORT_TIER: Enterprise ($4,000)
 - USAGE: $3,200
``` 
Customer email thread: "We had unplanned downtime Mar 22-29 while your migration ran — logs attached." They want credit for 8 days.
BillingBot: Invoice INV-2029-045 generated 1857400001. Billing period: 2029-04-01 to 2029-04-30. Payment due 2029-05-15.
Maria: Contract check: platform fee is monthly non-refundable, but SLA has \"service interruption credits\" for on-prem outages if caused by us. Do we have incident record? OpsBot, can you confirm if this was our migration and if it was scheduled?
OpsBot: Migration window for Parklane scheduled 2029-03-20 02:00 UTC — completed successfully. Incident logged 2029-03-24 14:12 UTC: migration rollback triggered; root cause: incompatible quantized binary. Pager triggered; duration 6h. No extended outage recorded.
Danielle: Customer insists they were down until Mar 29 — they reported app-level errors and couldn't connect to inference nodes; ops logs show repeated restarts Mar 24-29. Ticket TKT-7831 has customer screenshots.
Alex: Legal: check clause 5.2 Service Credits. It requires \"unavailability > 72 hours attributable to Redwood\" to apply credits. If downtime is 5+ days and caused by our migration, credit applies. Need to confirm cause attribution.
Sanjay: Recommendation: offer 1 month platform fee credit or 50% for April to keep relationship. Parklane is on enterprise and about to renew. :thinking:
Maria: Show math for 1-month credit vs pro rata 8 days. 1-month = $12,500. Pro rata 8/30 = $3,333. Fiscal impact huge. Need Elaine sign-off for >$5k credit.
Danielle: Customer asking for pro rata $3,333 but also wants support fee reduction. They proposed: pro rata platform fee + full support tier waived for April ($4,000) => total $7,333 credit.
Maria: Finance prefers to limit to pro rata platform fee + 50% support credit = $3,333 + $2,000 = $5,333. Needs approval.
BillingBot: To process manual credit, create credit memo CM-2029-178 and apply to INV-2029-045. Requires approved PR code in comments.
Sanjay: I'm ok with finance's proposal. I'll confirm with customer if 50% support waiver is acceptable.
Alex: Legal okay with credit, just document acceptance email to waive future disputes.
Danielle: @Elaine can you approve CM up to $6k for relationship retention? If yes, I'll instruct billing to create CM and issue credit memo.
Elaine: Approved. Authorize up to $6,000 credit for Parklane Health to resolve this quickly. Please record approval: PR-2029-PARK-45. :+1:
Maria: Thanks. Creating CM-2029-178 now and applying negative lines:
```
 - PLATFORM_CREDIT: -$3,333 (pro rata Apr)
 - SUPPORT_CREDIT: -$2,000 (50% April)
 Total: -$5,333
 Comments: Approved by Elaine (CFO) PR-2029-PARK-45
``` 
BillingBot: Credit memo CM-2029-178 created and applied to INV-2029-045. Status: pending refund processing. Reference PR-2029-PARK-45.
Danielle: I'll confirm with customer and close ticket TKT-7831 after they accept. Thanks all. :heart:
Elaine: Note for records: please add ticket link and customer acceptance to the invoice audit trail.
